understanding.goal_understanding: The objective in each level was to place every selectable piece onto goal tiles marked '+' in the semantic grid, with the requirement that all goals are occupied simultaneously to trigger a WIN; completing all levels in sequence would complete the full KA59 run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: The currently selected piece (shown as P) moved in 3-pixel increments per grid cell via MOVE_* actions, with movement sometimes blocked by walls/boundaries (#) or other objects. Certain adjacent objects (blocks, B) could be pushable so that attempting to move into them would shift them along if space permitted; otherwise the move would fail. Levels could contain multiple selectable pieces (S), and control could be switched by issuing a CLICK on the exact pixel-coordinate position of another selectable. The movement_blocked flags acted as hints about adjacency but did not guarantee a move would succeed or fail.
